thread:
lucy (ux): Quick design drop for the latency observability panel. Goals: clearer p95 comparator, a compact time-range picker, and a sampling control that shows "detection power". Prototype: https://img.redwood.internal/tmp/latency-panel-proto.png :sparkles:

omar (product): Nice! A few product asks: keep Last 1h/24h/7d presets, allow pinning a baseline, and default sampling = 100% for new orgs.

ben (eng): Default 100% makes sense. Implementation note: timepicker deep-links via query params {range, baseline, sampling}. For heatmaps, request coarse buckets when viewport < 600px to avoid big payloads.

mira (a11y): Accessibility: presets must be keyboard-focusable with aria-pressed. Heatmap cells need aria-labels like "14:00-14:05 p95 312ms, 120 reqs". Color-only intensity is an issue 12; add a pattern overlay or numeric tooltip.

lucy (ux): Will add a pattern toggle and increase hit targets to 44px. For the sampling control I'm proposing a small micro-stat: "Detection power: 78%" that updates as you slide. Also an auto-suggest button.

omar (product): Love "auto-suggest" but default it off for new orgs. Also show a short explanation: "Lower sampling reduces cost but may hide rare spikes." with a learn-more link.

ben (eng): Auto-suggest should be capped: min 1% unless org opts-in to 0.5%. For the scrubber, debounce drag events (150ms) and send immediate fetch on snap/mouseup. Pseudocode: ```js
let t;
scrubber.on('drag', e => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(()=>fetch(e.time),150); });
scrubber.on('snap mouseup', e => fetch(e.time));
```

mira (a11y): Simulate modal needs text-only results for screen readers and a progress announcement. If we show charts, include CSV export. Keyboard shortcuts: arrow keys to move between heatmap cells, Home/End jump.

lucy (ux): Good calls. I'll add: CI band for p95, a compact warning pill when sampling <20%: "Low sampling may miss spikes", and a one-click "apply recommendation" from simulate.

omar (product): Telemetry: track simulate_run, sampling_accepted, baseline_pinned. Also, pin persistence should be explicit (org vs user).

infra-bot: Heads-up: feature flags to add: sampling-auto-suggest=false, heatmap-folding=false. Staging deploy window 2026-04-05T04:00Z.

ben (eng): Backend: cache simulation results per-org for 12h and cap simulate to 7d by default to limit cost. Also return percentile CI to render shaded bands.

mira (a11y): Contrast note: pick palette + pattern combos meeting 4.5:1. Announce simulated numbers like "Estimated p95 at 10% sampling: 428ms, detection power: 42%".

lucy (ux): Next steps: update prototype with pinned baseline, CI band, pattern overlay, detection-power micro-stat, and annotated a11y hints. I'll post the revised link in ~2h. Thanks! :thumbsup:
